WORK TASK — Amend PR #117: Make Work Model Routing Useful and Truthful

Objective

Amend the existing open PR:

u-dont-existDOTcom/universal-dev-architecture#117

Do not start a replacement PR.

Preserve the good work already present: typed model/tier profiles, source-bound authorization, mismatch detection, no self-escalation, receipt/finalization binding, telemetry, dashboard visibility, and archive integrity.

Fix the blocking design issues identified by Chat review.

Do not merge or deploy.

1. Do not require independent readback for ordinary routing

Current product capability established by the PR:

model: SET_ONLY

effort: SET_ONLY

Fast: UNOBSERVABLE

The current v3 template defaults to SOL_MEDIUM + EXACT_PROFILE_REQUIRED. That makes ordinary nontrivial Work execution impossible on the present surface.

Change the contract so the normal usable state is:

Mission Control can prove which model/effort selection it requested/applied to the structured task-creation surface, while truthfully recording that the effective provider-side model/effort was not independently read back.

Do not call that MATCH or SET_AND_VERIFY.

Use an explicit assurance vocabulary such as:

SET_REQUEST_SUFFICIENT

INDEPENDENT_READBACK_REQUIRED

or an equally clear typed equivalent.

For SET_REQUEST_SUFFICIENT:

if the surface is SET_ONLY, the exact setter values must equal the source-authorized profile;

the applied setter request must be durably recorded;

observed/effective model and effort remain null unless independently verified;

preflight may proceed with a truthful state such as SET_REQUEST_ACCEPTED_UNVERIFIED;

finalization may succeed if every other contract condition passes;

receipt/dashboard must state that provider-side identity was not independently verified.

For INDEPENDENT_READBACK_REQUIRED:

current SET_ONLY capability must fail closed;

use this stronger mode when exact effective model identity is materially decision-relevant, e.g. a controlled Sol-vs-Astra calibration.

Do not silently treat setter evidence as independent verification.

Fast mode

The current surface cannot set or read Fast mode.

Do not make fastMode: false mean "we proved Fast was off."

Represent the current truth explicitly. Preferred semantics:

desired/request state: DO_NOT_ENABLE_FAST or equivalent;

observed Fast state: null;

capability: UNOBSERVABLE.

Ordinary execution may proceed under SET_REQUEST_SUFFICIENT if the launcher did not request/enable Fast through any exposed control. It must not claim the effective Fast state was independently verified.

2. Separate Chat-message provenance from directive-artifact integrity

Current bug:

validateExecutionProfile() effectively requires:

executionDirectiveBinding.directiveSha256 === sourceReceipt.bodySha256

Remove that equality requirement.

These are different objects:

sourceReceipt.bodySha256 = exact verified Chat message bytes;

directiveSha256 = exact execution-directive artifact bytes.

The architecture intentionally supports directives materialized as JSON/Markdown artifacts from a Chat turn. Their hashes normally differ.

Required binding:

a valid verified Chat source receipt exists;

the exact directive identity/revision/task exists;

the directive artifact has its own exact SHA-256;

the directive is durably linked to the verified Chat decision/source through existing reasoning/directive provenance fields;

the authorized Work profile equals the profile recorded in that exact directive.

Prefer binding against the durable execution_directive_recorded event/current directive state rather than trusting a worker-supplied hash alone.

If the current directive event lacks an exact artifact digest needed for this proof, add the smallest explicit digest/provenance field necessary.

Add a regression where Chat source digest A and directive artifact digest B are different, but the provenance is valid and admission succeeds. Add a negative control where directive digest or identity is wrong.

3. Remove or constrain the simple-unobservable escape hatch

The current schema permits SIMPLE_DETERMINISTIC_UNOBSERVABLE_ALLOWED on any routing tier.

Preferred repair: replace this with the general assurance distinction above:

SET_REQUEST_SUFFICIENT

INDEPENDENT_READBACK_REQUIRED

If a special deterministic exception remains, mechanically restrict it to the narrow deterministic tier and execution class; it must not apply to Astra or other materially model-sensitive profiles.

4. Task-creation bridge: discriminate before building

Do not invent a scheduler or unsafe automation.

Determine whether Mission Control can safely call the same existing structured consumer Work task-creation surface that the capability probe found can set model and reasoning effort.

Return one of:

TASK_CREATION_BRIDGE_EXISTING_AND_SAFE

TASK_CREATION_BRIDGE_IMPLEMENTABLE_WITH_EXISTING_AUTHORITY

TASK_CREATION_BRIDGE_BLOCKED_BY_PRODUCT_BOUNDARY

If an existing/authorized bridge is genuinely available, implement the smallest bridge so admission feeds exact model/effort into task creation, setter evidence is persisted, and no new credentials/API spend/bypass is introduced.

If blocked by product boundary, do not fabricate a bridge or add brittle browser automation. Keep the PR explicitly partially enforced and truthful.

5. Revisit the default directive

The canonical v3 directive should not default to an assurance mode that current ordinary Work can never satisfy.

Default bounded implementation should remain Sol Medium, Fast not requested, exact source-authorized setter required, and provider-side readback truthfully unverified unless available.

Use independent-readback-required only when Chat explicitly selects it because the decision depends on proving actual effective model identity.

Legacy artifacts remain explicit and must never acquire a fabricated model.

6. Telemetry truth

Keep the 10-task telemetry window, but distinguish model identity evidence:

SET_AND_VERIFIED

SET_REQUEST_ONLY

another precise current state

Telemetry under SET_REQUEST_ONLY may inform operational success/cost, but the later Chat review must not represent it as independently verified provider model identity.

7. Finalization

Finalization should reject:

source-authorized profile != setter request;

independently observed profile contradicts authorized profile;

required independent readback is absent;

unauthorized model/effort self-escalation;

wrong directive artifact/provenance binding.

Finalization should not reject ordinary SET_REQUEST_SUFFICIENT execution merely because provider readback is unavailable.

8. Tests required

Preserve all current green coverage and add/adjust focused regressions for:

Sol Medium + SET_REQUEST_SUFFICIENT + current SET_ONLY capability can proceed when exact setters were applied.

Astra Low + SET_REQUEST_SUFFICIENT can proceed when exact Astra/Low setters were applied, while observed provider model remains null/unverified.

INDEPENDENT_READBACK_REQUIRED fails on current SET_ONLY capability.

Setter mismatch fails closed.

Independent readback contradiction fails closed.

Fast mode is not falsely reported as verified off.

Chat source hash and directive artifact hash may validly differ.

Wrong directive artifact digest fails.

Wrong directive identity/revision fails.

Work cannot alter the source-authorized assurance requirement.

Work cannot self-escalate model or effort.

Legacy artifacts remain explicit and non-defaulted.

Telemetry marks SET_REQUEST_ONLY distinctly from verified identity.

Task-5/task-10 checkpoints remain non-mutating.

If a bridge is implemented, one consumer-seam test proves the exact authorized model/effort setter values reach the task-creation call.

Consumer seam:

A source-authorized Work profile must cause the exact model/effort setter request to reach the authorized Work launch surface when that surface is callable, and the receipt must distinguish setter evidence from independent provider readback. Missing readback must never be fabricated; it blocks only when Chat explicitly required independent readback.

9. Scope / archive

Keep existing source-archive mirror mechanics if repository policy requires them.

The regenerated archive parts are acceptable if reconstruction remains byte-identical.

Do not make unrelated Mission Control changes.

10. Verification / PR boundary

Amend PR #117 in place.

Before return:

focused consumer-seam tests;

Mission Control tests;

repository-required full suite/checkpoint;

typecheck/build if affected;

repository audit;

source archive reconstruction/integrity;

hosted PR checks as applicable.

Do not merge.
Do not deploy.
Do not purchase credits.
Do not change account/subscription settings.

Final receipt

Return:

PR 117 MODEL CONTRACT AMENDED

with:

new head SHA;

exact semantic changes;

capability classification;

task-creation bridge classification;

whether runtime status is:

PARTIALLY_ENFORCED_SET_ONLY

ENFORCED_SET_AND_VERIFY

CONTRACT_ONLY_BRIDGE_BLOCKED

source-message vs directive-artifact binding evidence;

consumer-seam test proving setter-only semantics;

all verification results;

remaining product limitation;

direct artifact bundle link/attachment.

Do not merge or deploy.

normalized_outcome: Amend PR 117 in place so ordinary source-authorized model and effort setters are usable under truthful SET_REQUEST_ONLY evidence, independent readback is required only when Chat explicitly asks for it, Fast remains unobserved, source-message and directive-artifact hashes remain distinct, and no unsafe task-creation bridge is fabricated.

required_outcomes.observable: SET_REQUEST_SUFFICIENT admits exact Sol Medium and Astra Low setter requests on the current SET_ONLY surface while observed provider model and effort remain null and identity evidence is SET_REQUEST_ONLY.

INDEPENDENT_READBACK_REQUIRED fails closed without independent provider identity, setter mismatches and observed contradictions fail closed, and Fast request intent never becomes a fabricated verified-off observation.
Admission binds different Chat source and materialized directive artifact digests through the current durable execution directive identity, revision, task, source provenance, and exact profile.
Receipts, finalization, telemetry, dashboard state, and 5/10 non-mutating checkpoints distinguish SET_REQUEST_ONLY from independently verified identity and preserve no-self-escalation.
The task-creation bridge is classified from current local product capability without inventing scheduler, browser automation, credentials, spend, deployment, merge, or account changes.
required_outcomes.blocked_reason: TASK_CREATION_BRIDGE_BLOCKED_BY_PRODUCT_BOUNDARY: the structured create_thread primitive is available only as an agent-side Codex desktop tool and is not an authenticated callable Mission Control runtime API; the existing relay targets supervisor Chat delivery, not Work task launch.

consumer_seam_acceptance: A source-authorized Work profile causes the exact model and effort setter request to be admitted and durably recorded when an authorized launcher can call the structured surface; receipts distinguish SET_REQUEST_ONLY from provider readback, and missing readback blocks only when Chat explicitly requires it.
non_satisfying_proxies: Calling setter evidence SET_AND_VERIFY or MATCH
Representing DO_NOT_ENABLE_FAST as independently verified Fast off
Equating the Chat source message digest with the directive artifact digest
Trusting a worker-supplied directive digest without current durable directive provenance
Inventing a scheduler, browser bridge, credential, spend, merge, or deployment
hard_boundaries: Do not purchase credits or change account settings
Do not fabricate a task-creation bridge
next_direct_evidence: After a separately authorized product integration exposes the Codex task-creation primitive as an authenticated Mission Control runtime API, connect the exact admitted model and effort setters and retain SET_REQUEST_ONLY unless independent readback is also exposed.
